title: The Hollow Ember Again
premise: Ada Galloway has survived twenty years in the magic-free city of Vell by hiding her gift for speaking with beasts, selling harmless charms and keeping her head down. When a dying courier presses a scorched map into her hands, she learns the covenant binding the human realm to the wild lands is failing—and that her long-dead mother helped break it. Hunted by the city's Wardens and guided by a cynical crow who remembers more than he admits, Ada must cross into the Hollow to reforge the covenant at the Ember Shrine before the solstice. She succeeds only by sacrificing her own memories of the man she loves, choosing duty over the life she built—until the covenant's renewal returns what she gave, transformed.
about_author: Kestrel Kavanagh is the pen name of a former wildlife rehabilitator who spent a decade listening to animals no one else could hear. They write fantasy about quiet people forced into loud destinies, and live somewhere with too many crows.

chapters.title: The Charm Seller's Quiet
chapters.summary: Ada's POV. We meet Ada in the market of Vell, selling charms and concealing her gift as a rat begs her for help escaping a trap. She refuses, hating herself for it. Emotional beat: the suffocating cost of invisibility, and the first crack in her resolve.

chapters.title: A Stranger's Last Breath
chapters.summary: Ada's POV. A wounded courier collapses in her shop, pressing a scorched map and an ember-stone into her hands while whispering that 'the Hollow is waking.' Wardens arrive; she hides him too late. Emotional beat: terror and reluctant inheritance—the map won't leave her now.

chapters.title: What the Crow Remembers
chapters.summary: Bramble the crow's POV. The crow who has shadowed Ada for years reveals he served her mother and knew the covenant's breaking firsthand. He offers to guide her if she finally speaks aloud to him. Emotional beat: uneasy alliance; Ada's gift acknowledged for the first time in decades.

chapters.title: The Warden's Oath
chapters.summary: Warden Elias Thorn's POV. Thorn, Ada's old friend and almost-lover, is ordered to hunt the charm seller tied to the courier's death. He recognizes the map's seal from his childhood. Emotional beat: loyalty to the city warring with loyalty to Ada—he falsifies his first report.

chapters.title: Crossing the Gray March
chapters.summary: Ada's POV. Ada and Bramble slip past the city walls into the blighted borderlands where beasts have gone silent and strange. A dying hart gives her the covenant's history through broken images: her mother's face among the betrayers. Emotional beat: grief reframing everything she believed about family.

chapters.title: The City That Forgot Its Name
chapters.summary: Bramble's POV. In a ruined waystation, Bramble recounts the night twenty years ago when the mages sealed the Ember and erased the city's memory of the pact—including Ada's mother's role as its last keeper, not its breaker. Emotional beat: truth as burden; Ada realizes her whole life was built on someone else's lie.

chapters.title: Thorn at the Ford
chapters.summary: Elias's POV. Thorn catches up to Ada at the river ford but lets her go, giving her his Warden blade as proof against other hunters. His deputy witnesses the betrayal. Emotional beat: love openly chosen over duty, knowing it will cost him everything.

chapters.title: The Hollow Opens
chapters.summary: Ada's POV. At the Hollow's threshold, the wild realm tests her: beasts demand she prove she is not her mother's shadow. She speaks her gift fully for the first time, and the land answers—but warns the shrine will take a price. Emotional beat: claiming her power and dreading its cost.

chapters.title: Ember and Ash
chapters.summary: Alternating Ada and Elias POVs converge at the shrine on solstice eve. Thorn arrives pursued by Wardens; to buy Ada time, he holds the pass alone. Ada reforges the covenant, and the Ember demands her memories of Elias as payment. Emotional beat: climax—she pays it, whispering goodbye to a man she can no longer name.

chapters.title: What Returns Transformed
chapters.summary: Ada's POV, weeks later. Magic is legal again; Vell remembers its name. A stranger with kind eyes visits her shop, and the ember-stone warms, returning her memories not as they were but grown richer—as if love kept living without her. Emotional beat: resolution—duty honored, love restored, and Ada finally visible.
